name: Inspiration Energy Corp.
summary: Inspiration Energy Corp., headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, is a company primarily involved in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties across Canada. The firm's efforts are concentrated on uncovering deposits of various valuable metals, including gold, copper, uranium, and other precious and base metals. Notably, it possesses full ownership of The Rottenstone North copper-gold project, located in the northern region of Saskatchewan. Founded in 2020, the company operated under the name Rock Edge Resources Ltd. until February 2024, when it officially adopted its current name, Inspiration Energy Corp.
